instruction: Please enable the background cone effect in VLC. I find the animated cone visualization aesthetically pleasing when the player is idle.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling the background cone visualization in VLC. Uses existing check_qt_bgcone metric function to verify the qt-bgcone setting is set to 1 (enabled) in the VLC configuration file.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to enable VLC background cone effect
Metric function check_qt_bgcone properly reads VLC config file and checks qt-bgcone setting
Expected value '1' correctly represents enabled state for qt-bgcone setting
Logic correctly handles both explicit (qt-bgcone=1 in file) and implicit (default behavior) cases
Postconfig appropriately restarts VLC to ensure config changes are persisted and readable
Parameter handling is correct: rule['expected_qt_bgcone'] directly accesses the rules dictionary
Complete coverage: instruction only requires enabling background cone, evaluator verifies exactly this
